0.text: After 3 months of development, we are pleased to present WaifuFactory v0.1.0. This release includes 21 worlds to explore and lots of other content. Thank you for playing!

1.text: I'm incredibly happy that so many people enjoyed the game! This inspired me to create a new update with many bug fixes and various additions that players requested. Thank you all for your love and support, see you in the new updates!
